newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis posts big profit rise, sales up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis posts big profit rise, sales up 14 pct.

text.p: Unlisted stores and supermarkets group John Lewis Partnership Plc said it raised its pre-tax profit by 72 percent to 78.1 million stg in the first half to July 27 on sales of 1.47 billion stg.
The profit figure compared with 45.5 million stg in the first half of last year.
Sales were up 14 percent from 1.29 billion stg in 1995, rising 89 million in the department store division and 93 million in Waitrose supermarkets.
The company said it had put aside a surplus of some 50.54 million stg which is available for retentions and profit sharing between the partners.
